name: Elytra Chestplate Swap
summary: Backports the feature from modern minecraft where you can easily swap elytra with chestplate back to 1.12.2
description: # Elytra Chestplate Swap ## Description **Elytra Chestplate Swap** is a simple quality-of-life mod for Minecraft Forge 1.12.2 that brings a modern convenience feature to older versions. With a single right-click, you can instantly swap your equipped chestplate with an elytra you're holding—and vice versa—without opening your inventory. ### How It Works (for the user) - **Hold an elytra** in your hand. - **Right-click** while holding it. - If you're wearing a chestplate, the elytra equips immediately, and the chestplate is placed directly into your hotbar (in the slot you were holding the elytra). - If you're already wearing an elytra and holding a chestplate, right-clicking swaps the chestplate onto your body and moves the elytra to your hotbar. No inventory opening, no dragging—just a quick right-click to switch between flight mode and protection mode.
author: Sekai0ni0Itamio
